name: Real-World GitHub Pricing (Desktop 1280×800) CTA Button Z-Index Collision

groundTruth.defect: Primary Call to Action signup button shifted vertically by -30px behind sibling elements with negative z-index: -1 and orange background.
groundTruth.rootCause: Negative z-index: -1 and translateY(-30px) causing button collision and occlusion
groundTruth.suggestedFix: Remove z-index: -1, remove translateY transform, and restore canonical green button styling
